reuse.why: Introduces one getBudgetableCategories selection that setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6/12MonthAvg (via a new setAllNMonthAvg) and the new setLastMonthSpending reuse, and the new action reuses getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages; only copyPreviousMonth does not use it.

duplication.why: copyPreviousMonth re-states every exclusion (income outside tracking, hidden/group hidden with the flag, saved templates, #fixed groups) as row checks, and the tests carry two near-identical runAll/runAllHidden loops.

placement.why: Selection, tag and template checks live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them; template parsing could have leaned on the goal-template module, but the layer is right.

scope.why: Changes stay within month-wide actions, their handler registration, tests and release notes; folding set6/12MonthAvg into setAllNMonthAvg is a related cleanup.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one exclusion rule, but the second copy in copyPreviousMonth must be kept in sync by hand for every future exclusion, as steps 3 and 4 already required.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts filters getBudgetData rows with its own hidden/template/#fixed/income checks instead of using getBudgetableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth reshapes the getBudgetableCategories rule into per-row early returns over getBudgetData (which gained goal_def/cat_group columns for it); runAll and runAllHidden in actions.test.ts are the same loop under two names.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetableCategories gained includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL hidden clause; copyPreviousMonth re-implements the whole selection instead of calling it.
